title: The web page and one-link set-up step is only tested when everything works
what: The set-up test walks the happy path: the three or two parts, making the page, sharing the link, turning the page off. Nothing checks the step for a gym with no plan to pick, a browser that blocks copying, a poster picture that fails, a page MettleUp took down, a turn-off that fails, the 'Link copied.' and 'Poster saved as a picture.' toasts, or that the front desk sees none of it.
expected: Each refusal and failure line of the step is seen on screen at least once, and the desk is shown nothing of it.
fix_line: Add browser checks for the no-plan, blocked-copy, picture-failed, taken-down and failed turn-off cases

title: Adding, editing and retiring a plan is never tested beyond one simple save
what: Plans are only ever added through one helper that fills four boxes and saves. No test checks the wrong-input words (no name, a 1e2 duration, an empty or bad price, a bad joining fee, bad PT sessions), the PT plan switch, editing a price, marking a plan 'Not for sale' and back, or the starter price list. These set what every member is charged.
expected: The plan sheet's wrong-input words, the PT switch, editing a price without changing old sales, retiring a plan, and the starter list are each tested on screen.
fix_line: Add a browser test for the plan sheet errors, PT plan, edit, retire and starter list

title: The Member questions page is checked on the server but almost never on screen
what: The server test covers who may see and answer each question well. On screen, a test only sees the menu count, the heading and the question text, and a trainer sends one reply from the bell. Nothing checks the letter counter, 'Sending…', the card moving to 'Answered and closed', the empty, not-online and error pages, the desk-without-tick words, or the closed-after-14-days line.
expected: The reply flow and each empty, refused and error state of Member questions is seen on screen, for the owner and for a trainer.
fix_line: Add a browser test for the reply flow and the empty, refused and error states

title: Training progress is never tested when it cannot show, or for a trainer opening full progress
what: The tests check the list, the tags and sending. Nothing checks the pages for a gym that is not online, a server without the feature, a failed read with Try again, a desk person without the Trainer tick, a trainer typing another trainer's member address, a trainer with no members, or a trainer opening full progress. The server refuses these correctly, but the words on screen are unchecked.
expected: Each refused, empty and error page of Training progress is seen on screen, and a trainer opens their own member's full progress.
fix_line: Add browser checks for the refused, empty and error pages and a trainer full-progress visit

title: The paid-features lock card in Settings has no screen test at all
what: The lock card and its save are tested only as code and on the server: the words, the last-changed line, the save call and the member's 7-day rule. No browser test opens the card, ticks or unticks it, sees the greyed Save, the toast or the last-changed line, or sees a failed save keep the owner's choice. The card is hidden today, so it would ship unseen when the switch goes on.
expected: Before the card is switched on, a browser test opens it, saves both ways, and sees a failed save.
fix_line: Add a browser test of the lock card before switching it on

title: Saving gym details is only tested for the GSTIN
what: The only browser test of the gym details card types a GSTIN. Nothing checks that a new name reaches the top bar and the member app, a bad UPI ID is refused, a branch's own details card and its save leave the other branch alone, a failed save, a cleared UPI ID removing the pay link, or the not-online card with its greyed timings button.
expected: The name, UPI ID, branch details, a failed save and the not-online card are each tested on screen.
fix_line: Add a browser test for name, UPI, branch details, failure and the not-online card

title: Pay MettleUp: the journey and the test disagree on what the front desk sees
what: The journey says the front desk sees 'Only the gym owner can pay MettleUp' with 'Sign in as the owner…'. The test locks a different page: the desk is stopped earlier by the general owner-only page, 'Only an owner can see this'. The page's own owner-only words are reached only by an owner without a key, which no test does.
expected: One answer, the same in the journey and the test, for what the desk sees at the Pay MettleUp address.
fix_line: Correct the desk lines in the Pay MettleUp journeys

title: A receipt is never really tested as the front desk
what: The desk opens a receipt in one test only to see who took the money. No test checks, as the desk, the receipt's buttons and figures, the WhatsApp message, a not-confirmed receipt, a cancelled receipt's banner, or a missing receipt. The owner's checks cover some of these, but the desk is the one who usually hands receipts over.
expected: The desk's receipt page, its WhatsApp button, the not-confirmed and cancelled cases are seen on screen signed in as the desk.
fix_line: Add a desk sign-in to the receipt browser test

title: Pay MettleUp is never tested when the send fails
what: The Pay MettleUp test covers not ready, not available, bad reference words, a duplicate, waiting, confirmed and not confirmed. It never makes the send fail, so the red line, the reference staying in the box, 'Sending…', the box emptying after a send, the wrong-amount words and the Try again page are unchecked.
expected: A failed send keeps the typed reference and shows the reason; Try again and the amount words are seen on screen.
fix_line: Add a failed send, a bad amount and a failed read to the Pay MettleUp test
